issues.claim: Шаблон к тому же разбирается во время компиляции. / The template is also parsed at compile time. The older way with the same effect is `LoggerMessage.Define`.
issues.problem: The source generator does not pre-parse the template at compile time in a way that removes runtime parsing. For a typed method with up to six parameters it emits a static `LoggerMessage.Define<int, decimal>(...)` delegate with `SkipEnabledCheck = true` plus its own `IsEnabled` check. The template is parsed once at static initialization. The source cited for this claim (the high-performance-logging page) says only that `LoggerMessage` parses the template once when the message is defined, not at compile time. Calling `LoggerMessage.Define` an 'older way with the same effect' also hides that the generated code is built on it.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace with: 'The template is parsed once when the message is defined, not on every call, and the generator checks the placeholders against the method parameters at compile time. The older manual way to get the same effect is `LoggerMessage.Define`, which the generated code uses internally.' Make the same change in the ru text.

issues.claim: `LogDebug` is declared as `LogDebug(this ILogger logger, string? message, params object?[] args)` ... A method generated with `[LoggerMessage]`, or a `_logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)` check before the call, removes the cost.
issues.problem: Option b is far longer and more detailed than the other options, so a candidate can pick it by length alone. The full signature and both fixes are also spelled out inside it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the distractors comparable in length and detail, or shorten b to the core claim: 'The `params object?[]` array and the boxed `int` and `decimal` are created at the call site before the level check; `[LoggerMessage]` or an `IsEnabled` guard avoids it.'

issues.claim: Спецификация W3C Baggage требует передавать все элементы, только пока их не больше 64 и размер заголовка не больше 8192 байт.
issues.problem: The phrase 'требует ... только пока' is awkward and can be read as 'requires propagation only up to the limit'. The English version is clearer.
issues.suggestedFix: Спецификация W3C Baggage требует передавать все элементы, если их не больше 64 и заголовок не больше 8192 байт. При превышении любого из лимитов участник вправе отбросить элементы, поэтому baggage не подходит для больших данных.
